title: Selling Plans — Order-Size Caps on Cancellation Administration Fees
content:
On **Selling Plans**, a cancellation administration fee withheld from a cancellation credit is held to a cap set by the size of the cancelled order, measured by the fee basis on its variable final value fee record.

**Rule.** The cancellation administration fee is capped at the large-order cancellation cap when the order's fee basis is at least the large-order basis, at the mid-order cancellation cap when it is at least the mid-order basis but below the large-order basis, and at the refund administration fee cap below the mid-order basis.

## Cap schedule

| Fee basis of the cancelled order | Cap on the cancellation administration fee |
|---|---|
| USD 1000.00 or more (the large-order basis) | USD 10.00 (large-order cancellation cap) |
| USD 250.00 or more but below USD 1000.00 (the mid-order basis up to the large) | USD 7.50 (mid-order cancellation cap) |
| Below USD 250.00 | The plan's refund administration fee cap |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical orders)

| Fee basis | Cap |
|---|---|
| USD 1000.00 | USD 10.00 |
| USD 999.99 | USD 7.50 |
| USD 250.00 | USD 7.50 |
| USD 249.99 | The plan's refund administration fee cap |

**Holding to the cap (hypothetical).** A fee worked out at USD 11.20 on an order with a fee basis of USD 1400.00 is held to USD 10.00.
